name: Debendra Lal/ଦେବେନ୍ଦ୍ର ଲାଲ୍

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Debendra Lal writes poetry in Odia. A 2022 contributor note in Lothlorien Poetry Journal identifies him as a lawyer who grew up in Kesinga, Odisha, and names his poetry books ‘Andhakshara’ and ‘Birodhavasa’. The journal published three of his poems in English translations by Pitambar Naik.

His two Kabita Live poems bring different pressures to bear on feeling. ‘ବିପ୍ଳବ’ uses repeated calls to wait as a bitter irony: resistance is postponed while humiliation and loss accumulate. ‘କେବେକେବେ’ moves towards tears, imagining suffering in a child, an elderly person, a labouring body and even animals. Its final turn also makes room for tears of gratitude.
